title: Forge CLI Exit Codes
description: Machine-readable description of the Forge CLI exit code namespace. Authoritative for tooling that validates or introspects exit codes. Human-readable counterpart: docs/reference/exit-code-ranges.md. Decision record: docs/decisions/ADR-018-exit-code-taxonomy.md.

version.description: Semantic version of the taxonomy. Incremented on additive changes; never on code reassignment (which is forbidden).

compatibilityPolicy.description: The taxonomy is additive-only: codes may be added, deprecated, but never reassigned or removed.

notes.description: Windows 32-bit exit codes are masked with & 0xFF to maintain cross-platform stability.
